notes:
Company background: small DTC apparel brand, ~30 employees, fast growth online. Wants smarter chat widget for product questions + order status automation. Primary driver: reduce CS load and speed product conversions.

Key privacy/retention concerns (customer quotes and paraphrase):
- "We cannot risk customer PII being used to train models."
- Asks: how long do logs live by default? can we opt-out per-tenant? can prompts be excluded from any training?
- Wants explicit purge API to delete all records for a customer or conversation.
- Interested in configurable retention windows (30 / 90 / 365 days) and ability to set per-account policy from Console.
- Wants assurance logs are encrypted at rest; prefers KMS support (not currently required for Hosted but asks if roadmap includes tenant KMS).
- Audit trails requested: who accessed raw prompts/response logs, exportable audit logs for partners.

Technical notes from SE:
- Adopted Hosted API for POC. Ran sample chat flows with widget. Saw token-level cost breakdown in Console.
- Customer asked about default policy: Redwood Hosted keeps request logs for 30 days then aggregates; wants written confirmation and option to opt-out.
- SE showed sandbox flag X-Redwood-NoStore — customer wants this documented and surfaced in SDKs.

Commercial: low dollar ARR expected initially; will scale if retention/opt-out meets legal requirements.

Stated timeline: decision depends on legal sign-off; target POC in April 2026.
